Commentary.Commentary: Right then! This brings us to the end of the proceedings from the first T20I. But we will be back on Tuesday, 14th December for the second T20I between Pakistan and West Indies which will begin at 6 pm Local (1 pm GMT). Do join us for the build up in advance. Till then, goodbye and cheers!

Babar Azam, the skipper of Pakistan, says that they batted really well and credits Haider Ali by saying that he played a good innings. Adds that Mohammad Nawaz finished extremely well with the bat and he even bowled well in the middle overs. Tells that they would look to utilize the bench strength of their squad in the remaining games.

Nicholas Pooran, the West Indies skipper. says that they gave away 20 runs extras but adds that they could have chased it. He adds that it is about execution and learning as fast as possible. Tells that the ball turned a little and they lost the momentum by losing wickets to spinners.

Haider Ali, is the Player of the Match for his outstanding knock with the bat. He says that he will rate this innings 10 out of 10 and adds that Rizwan supported him well during his innings. He adds that the pitch was difficult and they wanted to take chances against seamers and pick the bowlers to hit.
Stay tuned for Presentation...

Pakistan were outstanding with the ball right from the word go and it was Mohammad Nawaz who set the tone upfront. However, it was Mohammad Wasim who opened the floodgates and the Windies' batters had no answers to it. Shadab Khan was introduced after the Powerplay and he too was exceptional as he picked up three crucial wickets and put the visitors on the back foot. It was Wasim who came back to bowl at the fag end and he cleaned up the tail in no time.

West Indies had a mountain to climb as they needed 201 runs to win but they did not start well and lost 3 wickets inside the Powerplay. Shai Hope dug in but he too perished just when he was looking to up the ante. Windies batters were finding it hard to time the ball in the middle and kept losing wickets at regular intervals. Rovman Powell came lower down the order and he hit a couple of lusty blows but threw away his wicket. It was Romario Shepherd and Odean Smith who swung their willow at the fag end but it was too late and the asking rate kept creeping up. In the end, the hosts suffered a comprehensive defeat of 63 runs.

This has been a comprehensive performance from Pakistan and they go 1-0 up in the three-match series! They also become the first team to win 18 T20Is in a calendar year! West Indies never really got going in the chase and they would be extremely disappointed with their batting effort.

OUT! BOWLED! It's all over! Mohammad Wasim finishes with four wickets! Mohammad Wasim bowls this from 'round the wicket and on a length, on off. Oshane Thomas presses forward to defend but misses as the ball sneaks through the gap between bat and pad and shatters the stumps. Another wicket for Mohammad Wasim and this has been a brilliant display of bowling by the young man. Pakistan complete another dominant performance and they win by 63 runs!
WIDE! Full and down the leg side this time. Oshane Thomas looks to flick it away but misses. Wide called.
A full ball, on leg. Akeal Hosein flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
A low full toss, on off. Thomas pushes it to covers for a single.
A yorker, around off. Oshane Thomas blocks it out.
Oshane Thomas is the last man in.

OUT! BOWLED! Another excellent delivery from Wasim and gets rid of Romario Shepherd this time! Wasim bowls a perfect yorker, around off. Shepherd fails to dig it out and the ball cannons onto his off stump.
Slower ball, on a length, outside off. Romario Shepherd flat-bats it to long off but does not take a single.
Akeal Hosein walks out to bat.

OUT! BOWLED! Shaheen Afridi gets his revenge! A full and straight ball on middle. Odean Smith backs away a little and looks to heave it across the line but misses this time. The ball shatters the stumps and Odean Smith has to walk back. End of an entertaining innings from Odean Smith.
SIX! This time he has deposited over the fence! Afridi misses his yorker and bowls this full on middle. Odean Smith gets under it and tonks it over long on for a biggie.
FOUR! Wow a helicopter shot this time! Almost a yorker on middle. Odean Smith gets under it and plays a helicoper shot towards long off for a boundary.

DROPPED! A Length ball, on off. Romario Shepherd gets under it and looks to go big over long on. But gets the bottom of his blade and the ball goes straight into the hands of Mohammad Nawaz at long on. Mohammad Nawaz there drops a sitter and a single is taken in the end.
A length ball, angling into middle. Odean Smith looks to work it away but gets a thick outside edge to third man for a single.
FOUR! Odean Smith is just displaying the power he has! A full ball, on off. Odean Smith backs away and drills it to long off for a boundary.
Swing and a miss again! An off-pace delivery on a length, on off. Romario Shepherd swings hard across the line but misses.
A full ball, on middle. Smith pushes it to long on for just a single.
A slower length ball, around off. Odean Smith swings across the line but misses again.
SIX! Short ball and punished! A short ball, on middle. Odean Smith hangs back and pulls it high and handsome over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
A length ball, outside off. Smith swings but misses again.

Short and wide outside off. Odean Smith looks to cut it but misses. Mohammad Rizwan behind the stumps catches it and convinces Babar Azam to take a review. He takes it but the UltraEdge shows no spike. So just a dot ball.
Babar Azam has opted for a review for caught behind! Mohammad Rizwan feels that he heard something and asks his skipper to refer it. Nothing on the UltraEdge and Pakistan lose a review.
Back of a length, on middle. Romario Shepherd just pushes it back to the bowler. 90 needed now from 24 balls.
Back of a length, outside off. Odean Smith backs away and slaps it to sweeper cover for a single.
WIDE! Short and down the leg side. Odean Smith looks to pull but misses, Wide called.
A full toss, on middle. Romario Shepherd hits this inside out towards deep cover for a single.
A full ball, on off. Odean Smith backs away and hits it to the cover fielder in the ring for a single.
Back of a length, around leg. Romario Shepherd tucks it to the leg side and takes a run.
Slower ball, on a length, outside off. Romario Shepherd looks to heave it away but he misses.
Fuller ball, on middle. Driven to long on for a single.
A full ball, middle. Romario Shepherd drives it to long on and gets a single. There is a direct hit at the bowler's end and the batters take an extra run as the ball deflects away.
WIDE! Short and down the leg side. Romario Shepherd looks to pull but misses.
FOUR! A low full toss, on middle. Romario Shepherd whips this off his pads and hits it wide of long on for a boundary.
SIX! This time deposited over the fence! Full ball, on middle. Romario Shepherd gets under it and hammers it over long on for a biggie.
FOUR! Fuller on off. Romario Shepherd backs away and smashes it through covers for a boundary.
A yorker on middle. Romario Shepherd jams it out.
AND AGAIN! Odean Smith is certainly not picking Shadab Khan! Another ball, on a length, outside off and spinning away late. Odean Smith looks to block but he misses.
Tossed up, on a length, outside off. Odean Smith looks to sweep but he misses as the ball spins past his blade.
Flatter ball, outside off. Odean Smith looks to poke at it but he misses out yet again.
A googly, outside off. Odean Smith looks to block but the ball sneaks through his bat.
OUT! TAKEN! Tossed up, on a length, around middle. Rovman Powell hits it straight to Mohammad Nawaz at long on who takes a good catch. West Indies are in deep trouble now.
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Nawaz b Shadab Khan

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up, on a length, outside off. Rovman Powell looks to slog but he misses.
A slower length ball, on off. Rovman Powell looks to defend but gets surprised as that bounce grips off the surface and hits him on the gloves for a single to the on side.
SIX! BOOM! Tossed up, around middle. Rovman Powell smokes it over long on and collects a biggie.
Good-length ball, on leg. Romario Shepherd nudges it to the leg side for a run.
Back of a length, outside off. Romario Shepherd looks to cut but he misses.
Short of a length, outside off. Rovman Powell steers it to third man for a single.
Romario Shepherd is the next batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another one bites the dust! A slower ball, into the pitch, outside off. Dominic Drakes looks to heave it away but it goes off the toe end towards the long on region. Mohammad Nawaz runs in from long on and takes a good catch. West Indies slip further!
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Nawaz b Haris Rauf

Commentary.Commentary: Haris Rauf is back into the attack.
DROPPED! A quicker ball, on a length, around off. Rovman Powell looks to block but it goes off the outside edge towards Babar Azam at first slip who drops it. 122 runs needed off 48 balls.
SIX! BANG! Tossed up, in the slot, around middle. Rovman Powell smokes it over the long on region for a biggie.
Flatter ball, outside off. Rovman Powell chips it over the point region and scampers through for the second run.
FOUR! Top shot! Fuller in length, around middle and leg. Rovman Powell gets down on his knee and paddles it to the vacant fine leg region for a boundary.
Tossed up, around off and spinning away sharply. Rovman Powell prods but sways away from the line of the ball.
Flatter ball, outside off and turning away late. Rovman Powell looks to poke at it but the ball goes past his blade.
Overpitched ball, on middle. Rovman Powell squeezes it out to the leg side and the batters collect a run.
Tossed up, around off. Rovman Powell blocks it out.
A bit quicker, on a length, outside off. Dominic Drakes cuts it towards the cover region for a run.
FOUR! Nicely timed! Flatter ball, around leg. Dominic Drakes rocks back and just whips it to wide of deep square leg for a boundary.
Flatter ball, darted on the pads. Dominic Drakes tucks it to square leg.
Flatter ball, outside off and turning away late. Rovman Powell pushes it past the point fielder for a single.
Tossed up, on a length, around off. Dominic Drakes presses forward to defend this one.
Flatter ball, on off. Dominic Drakes blocks it off the front foot.
Dominic Drakes is the new man in.

OUT! BOWLED! Shamarh Brooks' misery ends! A flatter delivery on middle. Shamarh Brooks dances down the track and looks to slog it away but he is no position to connect the ball. The ball misses his swinging bat and then shatters the stumps. Shadab Khan gets the second wicket in the over and West Indies are crumbling under the pressure here.
Slower in the air on middle and turning away. Brooks defends this off the front foot towards the off side.
Full toss on middle. Powell pushes it to long on for a single.

DRINKS! Pakistan are bossing the game right now and West Indies badly need a big partnership to get back in this game. They have some big hitters to follow and they will need to get going straightaway. Rovman Powell walks out to bat.

OUT! LBW! Shai Hope departs now! A fuller ball, on middle. Shai Hope just like his partner in the last over looks to sweep but misses. The ball hits his pads and this time it looks dead straight. Pakistan players appeal and the umpire raises his finger. Shai Hope knows he is out too and decides against taking a review. He walks back to the hut and West Indies are in deep trouble now.
Shamarh Brooks opts for a review after being adjudged LBW! The Ball Tracker indicates that the ball was missing the off stump and Brooks survives!

NOT OUT! Shamarh Brooks survives! A quicker delivery on off. Shamarh Brooks gets on his knees and looks to sweep but misses. The ball hits his pads and there is a huge appeal. The umpire raises his finger but Shamarh Brooks reviews. The replays roll in and the Ball Tracker shows that the ball is missing the off stump. So the decision is overturned and that is a good review by Brooks.
Fuller and outside off. Brooks looks to push at it but gets beaten.
Fuller on off. Brooks tries a slog-sweep but misses as the ball turns away sharply.

DROPPED! Fuller on middle. Hope skips down the track and looks to go downtown but gets the bottom of his blade. The ball goes in the air towards long off and Shaheen Afridi running in gets the hand to the ball but drops it. A single taken.
Flatter, on off. Brooks dabs it to backward point for a single.
Beaten! A quicker ball, on middle. Brooks looks to work it away but gets beaten as the ball turns away sharply.
Fuller delivery on off. Hope drives it back to the bowler.
Shorter length and turning away. Brooks pushes it off the back foot to covers for a single.
Fuller on off. Defended off the front foot.
Quicker on off. Hope pushes it behind square on the off side for a single.
Shorter length, on off. Brooks works it off the back foot to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller on middle. Hope sweeps it to deep square leg for just a single.
Shadab Khan comes into the attack.
Shorter length, on off. Brooks cuts it off the back foot to point. 148 needed now from 78 balls.
Another quicker delivery around off. Brooks late cuts it to short third man.
Darted on middle. Hope makes room and pushes it to covers for a single.
Fuller on middle. Brooks works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter length, on off. Hope pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Full ball, on off. Shai Hope gets on his knees and smashes it straight down the ground for a boundary.
Mohammad Nawaz comes back to bowl.
Drifting on leg again. Brooks looks to clip it but misses. The ball brushes his thigh and goes to the keeper.

A length ball, on off. Hope dabs it to backward point and takes off for a quick single. Shadab Khan running in fires in a direct hit at the batter's end. But the replays confirm that the batter is safe and a single is taken.
FOUR! Wrong line and punished! A length ball, on pads. Hope just tucks it fine towards long leg for a boundary.
On a length, on leg. Brooks clips it to behind square on the on side for a single.
Shamarh Brooks walks out to bat.

OUT! LBW! A brilliant yorker again! Mohammad Wasim bowls this pacy yorker on middle and leg. Devon Thomas looks to jam it out but misses. Gets hit on the pads and there is a huge appeal. The umpire raises his finger and another West Indies batter is undone by a brilliant yorker.
On a length, on middle. Hope clips it to deep square leg for a single.
WIDE! Full and down the leg side. Hope looks to flick it but misses. Wide called.
Short of a length, outside off. Shai Hope stays back and steers it to third man for a single. Just 5 runs off the over!
Good running! Length ball, just outside off. Devon Thomas pushes it to wide of mid off and scampers through for a run.
Length ball, on the pads. Shai Hope clips it to deep square leg for a single.
On a length, around off. Devon Thomas defends it to cover.

Full ball, outside off. Shai Hope looks for a booming drive but it goes off the inner half of the blade back past the bowler. Shaheen Afridi moves across to his left from mid on and keeps it to just one.
Length ball, angling in from middle. Shai Hope drives it towards mid on.
Back of a length, around off. Devon Thomas gets behind the line of the ball to block this one out.
Devon Thomas is the next man in.

OUT! BOWLED! What a delivery to get rid of the dangerous Nicholas Pooran! Wasim hurls a pin-point yorker, around off. Pooran looks to jam it out but he gets beaten for pace and misses it. The ball crashes onto his off pole. West Indies lose their second wicket and are in a spot of bother now.
A yorker, outside off. Nicholas Pooran looks to dig it out but he misses.
SIX! Another maximum from Nicholas Pooran! A short ball and around leg. Nicholas Pooran hangs back and pulls it over deep square leg for a maximum.
A full ball, on pads. Hope flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Full and punished! An overpitched delivery on off. Shai Hope leans forward and drives it wide of mid off for a boundary.
Mohammad Wasim is into the attack now.
Length delivery, around off. Pooran prods and blocks it out.
FOUR! Crunched! Full ball, outside off. Nicholas Pooran chips it over mid off and collects a boundary.
A yorker-length delivery, around middle. Nicholas Pooran tucks it to mid-wicket.
Another slower ball, on a length, around middle. Shai Hope looks to flick but it goes off the inner half towards mid on. The batters cross for a run.
Length ball, angling in from middle. Nicholas Pooran clips it to wide of mid on for a single.
An off-pace delivery, outside off. Shai Hope looks to drive on the up but he gets a thick outside edge towards third man for a run.
Flatter ball, darted on the pads. Shai Hope tucks it to the leg side and collects a single.
Tossed up, around off. Shai Hope pushes it to cover.
Fuller on off. Pushed off the front foot towards mid off for a single.
SIX! Nicholas Pooran gets into the act straightaway! A full ball, on off. Nicholas Pooran gets under it and just tonks it over long on for a biggie.
Flatter and quicker outside off. Pooran looks to defend it but gets beaten.
Nicholas Pooran walks in at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT! A very soft dismissal and Brandon King has to walk back. Flatter ball, outside off and sticking into the surface. Brandon King looks to push it to the off side but it hits the shoulder of his bat and the ball goes straight to Babar Azam at extra cover who takes an easy catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Babar Azam b Mohammad Nawaz

Commentary.Commentary: Mohammad Nawaz to start from the other end.
FOUR! Pure class from Shai Hope! An overpitched delivery on off. Shai Hope leans forward and drives it through covers for a lovely boundary.
Fuller on off. Driven to mid off. Dot ball again.

A full ball, around off. Hope looks to drive it but gets the inside edge back to the keeper. There is an appeal for a caught behind but the replays show that the ball has hit the ground after hitting his bat.
The umpires are checking if that is caught behind. Shaheen Afridi feels that he has got his man here. The replays roll in and it suggests that the ball bounced before going to the keeper.
On a length, on middle. King works it to square leg for a single.
Fuller on middle. Hope pushes it to mid on and gets a single. Shai Hope gets off the mark.
A full toss on middle and shaping in. Hope blocks it out.
WIDE! Full and down the leg side to start from Afridi. Shai Hope looks to clip it but misses. Wide called.
